# Owned Map

> Owned Map is a web app that puts everything a person owns (property, vehicles, boats, aircraft, land, parking and equipment) on one interactive map, with the value, income, expenses, yield and net worth of each asset side by side.

Owned Map is a paid subscription product with a 7-day free trial (card required, charged only when the trial ends). Values are entered by the user; Owned Map does not pull market prices.

## What it does
- Shows every asset on an interactive map with a Globe view and a Country view, in any country.
- Tracks value, purchase cost, yearly income, expenses and debt per asset, and calculates appreciation, net income, yield and net worth. Supports partial ownership by percentage.
- Handles houses, apartments, commercial buildings, warehouses, land, parking spaces, cars, trucks, motorcycles, motorhomes, yachts, sailboats, jet skis, aircraft and heavy equipment.
- Attaches documents (deeds, insurance, contracts), fills in asset details from an uploaded document, and sets reminders for renewals.
- Exports PDF, Excel (.xlsx) and CSV reports, and imports assets from CSV.

## Pricing
- $47 per month includes 3 assets. Extra assets cost $15 each for assets 4 to 10, $10 each for assets 11 to 25 and $5 each from the 26th, up to 100 assets (25 assets: $302 a month, 100 assets: $677 a month).
- Yearly billing is 30% less than monthly.
- 7-day free trial.
